en.name: Leper Gnome
en.ability: When a Townsfolk player chooses you with their own ability, they immediately become a Leper Gnome, and you lose all your abilities. You win or lose with evil, even if you are dead.

zh.name: 麻风侏儒
zh.ability: 镇民玩家使用自身能力选择你时，会立即变成麻风侏儒，且你失去所有能力。你的胜负条件与邪恶玩家相同，即使你已死亡。
